caption_L1: Here a bar diagram is titled Uganda : Ratio of government expenditure to gross domestic product (GDP) from 2015 to 2025. A linear scale of range 0.00 to 0.20 can be seen along the y-axis, labeled Ratio of government expenditure to GDP. The x-axis measures Year.
caption_L2L3: The bar chart shows an increase in the ratio between 2015 to 2025. From 2015-2018, spending held steady at just over 0.15.  In 2019, the ratio increased to 0.19, and continued to increase above 0.20 until 2022. 2022 and 2023 held level, with a small decrease in 2024 (but remaining above 0.20). 2025 indicates a return to the ratio seen in 2022 and 2023.
